digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend assembly and contract validation
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend must implement query_project and assert_env_ready to satisfy the Backend runtime-checkable protocol, currently failing isinstance checks
The reconciler.backend configuration choice must widen from {"jira"} to {"jira", "jira-datacenter"} to make the registered DC backend reachable through config loading

DC inbound identity minting requires accepting name/key as external identifiers (Cloud uses accountId) and mapping the 'jira-datacenter' vendor to the shared 'jira' creation channel to prevent store vocabulary fragmentation
The contract suite fixture must parametrize across both jira and jira-datacenter backends, holding both to identical port assertions without weakening any assertion

A writing reconcile pass against Jira DC crashes on missing set_entity_property method that the TicketTransport protocol never declared but the core calls from three sites, indicating an incomplete port specification
